question: What is e-Sawaari that was launched by Niti Ayog in December 2021 in partnership with Convergence Energy Service Limited (CESL) and World Resources Institute, India (WRI India), and supported by Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI)?

options.text: Portal for all information on electric vehicles
Mobile app for state run buses and Indian railways
Scheme for 100% electrification of broad gauge railway routes across India
Electric Bus Coalition for Accelerating deployment of e-buses in India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Electric Bus Coalition for Accelerating deployment of e-buses in India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **e-Sawaari** is an Electric Bus Coalition launched by Niti Ayog in December 2021 in collaboration with CESL and WRI India.
 
• The initiative aims to accelerate the deployment of electric buses (e-buses) across India to promote sustainable urban mobility.
 
• The coalition provides a platform for stakeholders, including government agencies, bus operators, and financiers, to share knowledge and best practices regarding e-bus adoption.
 
• This program is supported by the **Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI)**, which focuses on improving urban mobility and reducing carbon emissions globally.
 
• It seeks to address challenges such as financing, operational efficiency, and infrastructure development for electric buses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric Buses:**

 
 
• Electric buses are an eco-friendly alternative to traditional diesel-powered buses, reducing greenhouse gas emissions and air pollution.
 
• They use electric motors powered by batteries and are considered crucial for sustainable urban transport.
 
• India’s push for electric buses aligns with its commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2070.
 
 
 
• **Convergence Energy Services Limited (CESL):**
 
 
• CESL is a subsidiary of Energy Efficiency Services Limited (EESL), focusing on clean energy projects and sustainable development.
 
• It plays a key role in managing and implementing initiatives like e-Sawaari.
 
 
 
• **World Resources Institute (WRI India):**
 
 
• WRI India is a research organization that works on sustainable development, with a focus on urban mobility, climate, and energy.
 
• It collaborates with governments and stakeholders to support initiatives like e-Sawaari.
 
 
 
• **Transformative Urban Mobility Initiative (TUMI):**
 
 
• TUMI is a global initiative led by Germany to promote sustainable urban mobility in developing countries.
 
• It supports the development of electric mobility solutions, including e-buses, to combat climate change.
